children: X4 posted an updated corporate presentation announcing full enrollment for the pivotal 4WARD Phase 3 study expected in Q4 2026 and topline data expected H1 2028.
Updated corporate presentation filed as Exhibit 99.1 and posted on X4's investor website.
Full enrollment of the 4WARD Phase 3 chronic neutropenia study expected in Q4 2026; topline data expected H1 2028.
Primary endpoints: ANC response (>500 cells/µL) and annualized infection rate; both powered >96% for ITT.
Company reports $208M cash on hand as of June 30, 2026 with cash runway expected into 2029.
Mavorixafor (XOLREMDI) approved for WHIM in U.S. and EU; potential U.S. approval for chronic neutropenia targeted late 2028/early 2029.
